additions.name: Rary's Arcane Conversion
additions.summary: Instantly lose a prepared wizard spell and replace it with another spell from your spellbook.

notes: Book page = PDF page index - 1 (e.g. PDF 97 shows printed page 96).
Rary's Arcane Conversion: Level line is 'Wizard 6' (wizard only, no sorcerer); added at level 6. Book has no Saving Throw / Spell Resistance lines.
Lightning Leap and Lash of Force: app stored the combined-label value in 'area'; moved to 'target' with targetLabel per the field rules ('area' update value null = clear the field).
Otiluke's Suppressing Field: app name 'Impressing' is an OCR misread; spell header and chapter spell list both read 'Suppressing'.
Genius Loci school line is printed 'Conjuration (Creation) [see text]'; app descriptors [] left as is (the bracket is a placeholder, not a real descriptor).

Book prints non-subschool words in parentheses on some school lines: Crystalline Memories 'Transmutation (Mind-Affecting)', Channeled Sound Blast 'Evocation (Sonic)', Unicorn Blood/Heart/Horn 'Transmutation (Good)'. App stores these as subschool exactly as printed; left unchanged (they are arguably descriptors).
Bigby's Slapping Hand is not in the spell chapter; it appears in a sidebar on book page 144 (PDF 145). Stats match the app.
Sor/Wiz-ineligible spells skipped: Arcane Fusion and Arcane Fusion, Greater (Level: Sorcerer 5 / Sorcerer 8, sorcerer only). Critical Strike is Assassin 1 only.

Functions-like spells (Attentive Alarm, Escalating Enfeeblement, Incendiary Slime, Karmic Backlash, Karmic Retribution, Dimension Jumper Greater, Mordenkainen's Trusted Bloodhound, Seed of Undeath Greater) print only some stat lines; unprinted fields left as in app.
